question.text: An AI-only scheme of an AIF may extend its tenure by a maximum of:

explanation.text: The Logic: An AI-only scheme of an AIF may extend its tenure by a maximum of five years, inclusive of any tenure already extended prior to the scheme's conversion to AI-only. This contrasts with the standard close-ended AIF rule that permits extension by up to two years. The Trap: The five-year limit is inclusive of prior extensions — so if a regular scheme had already been extended by one year before converting to AI-only, only four additional years of extension would remain available. Note: Compare the two extension rules: standard close-ended schemes get up to two years, while AI-only schemes get up to five years (inclusive of any pre-conversion extension). The five-year ceiling is cumulative, not additive.
